hard_claims: C1: The contract was extracted from the composition's ACTUAL seams, with every element carrying a status from {DELIVERED-VERIFIED, DELIVERED-HOST-ONLY, IN-FLIGHT, GAP} plus file:line provenance into existing worker receipts or consumed sources; no status was upgraded without cited in-game evidence.

C2: DELIVERED-VERIFIED elements are exactly those with real in-game evidence: activation mechanics + lease registration (launch-9 supplier plugin ran to lease registration, spans=6/reg=6), runtime-status channel (sessions 234/273 written and read back), UE4SS.log mirror, t= stamps, configured roots, slot-0 address (zcode_anchor_validation_RESULTS + igf6 promotion), launch-8/9 named refusals (code=1 geometry, code=2 lease, aligned-entry geometry), lifecycle failed paths, and the launch-9 entry harness's in-game synthetic Lua VM. C3: The input surface is formalized as 5 groups (activation IN-ACT-1..5, seed slots IN-SEED-0..10 with validation classes, settings keys IN-SET-1..10, pad source IN-PAD-1..3, capture/lease/spanpub policy IN-POL-1..5); the output surface as the 14-element Lua API load-time surface + degraded/gapped items, 17 internal-API elements across tick pump / enqueue-drain / mod chain / diagnostics, the 7-stage lifecycle with the runtime-status state channel, and the 11-group named-refusal taxonomy.

C4: The reuse analysis classifies each contract element as UE-generic (reusable as-is), game-specific (L3-supplied: identity, capture geometry, seed values+derivations, version pins, layout ini contents, loadlist, pad profile, spawn-rung addresses), engine-version-specific (L2-internal: ~317 IsBelow/IsAtLeast sites, ~40 predicate pairs 4.8-5.8, named families: FField 4.25 split, script-hook 4.22 split at LuaMod.cpp:7682, UDynamicClass 4.11-5.4, FAssetData 4.17+/5.1+, FFrame 5.1, versioned container publication + S2 gate, layout identity agreement, width coverage table), and platform-specific (249 __PROSPERO__ sites + the PS5 substrate), with a porting sequence sketch.

C5: Honesty markers are part of the contract: prediction-pinned oracle shapes (spanpub markers, walkguard rows W1-W7) are labeled as never-live; the r3-armed drain is labeled GAP (proven not composable); spawn capability is labeled GAP (candidate LOAD-CAPABLE, NOT SPAWN-CAPABLE by construction); the PC-Townfall L3 profile is a placeholder.
